def transform(grid):
    """Shear each colored cell left by its distance above the bottommost colored row."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    out = [[0 for _ in row] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        nc = c - (bottom - r)
        if 0 <= nc < len(grid[r]):
            out[r][nc] = grid[r][c]
    return out
PY
